source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: convertMailTab reads selectedRow?.modeName and adds folderMode only when the mapped mode is truthy. The local mapper passes undefined through, and the schema declares the property optional. The mode-update and message-selection paths also tolerate a missing selected row at lookup, with the latter retaining a fallback to other enabled modes. Keep this extension guard separate from the earlier New Message view-wrapper repair. No extension runtime result is claimed.
title: MailTab conversion omits folderMode when no folder row is selected
